correctness_corrections: SavedState.token and the local token are signed int.
The exact declaration is int fn_801FA410(int), and its return is explicitly discarded.
Globals.saved contains five 0x14-byte records, consistent with lbl_8063D488 size 0x64.
aggregate_reconstruction: Globals is a C reconstruction spanning adjacent linker labels beginning at lbl_8063C6B8; it is not a claim that the linker symbol alone owns the full aggregate extent.
bounds: Index safety relies on the external invariant 0 <= lbl_8064D7BC <= 5. This invariant is not proven locally, and no runtime guard was added.
relocation_note: All five real relocations preserve type, target and addend. The store and call relocation offsets shift eight bytes earlier because generated code omits two retail pointer addi instructions. Objdiff R_PPC_NONE entries are derived address annotations, not ELF relocations.
authorized_trial: Deferring first and second pointer assignments into their first stores produced the identical 116-byte text and identical 83.09677 scores in none, name_address and all modes, so the trial was retired.
divergence: Retail materializes first and second live-state pointers with addi r6,r5,0xCC0 and addi r5,r5,0xD48. GC/1.3 omits both, uses shared-base stores at 0xCF0, 0xD78, 0xD30 and 0xDB8, and selects a different register/load/store schedule.
